purpose: Free-first selection and justified paid exceptions.
use: Choosing a tool, service, dependency or any action with a monetary or quota cost: prefer adequate free/local options and justify paid ones.
semantic_conditions: Free-first applies unless security, reliability or authority would be compromised.
mandatory_preconditions: Known alternatives with their setup and recurring costs.
postconditions_verification: Selection rationale recorded; no paid dependency without justification and authority.
